title: Combobox with autocomplete suggestions
description: A text input that suggests matching options as the user types (places, people, tags, products), with keyboard navigation through suggestions, highlighted matches, loading and no-match states, and support for free text when the domain allows it.
intent: Help users enter a value from a large set quickly and correctly, while still allowing typing.
characteristics: input plus popup listbox of suggestions
matched substring highlighted in each option
loading, no-match, and error states inside the popup
clear distinction between free text and selected option
debounced remote queries with result caching
interaction: Down arrow opens and moves through options, Enter selects, Escape closes then clears; selecting fills the input and closes the popup; Tab leaves without forcing a selection.
responsive: Popup width matches the input; on narrow screens the popup can expand to a full-width sheet with the input pinned at the top so the keyboard does not cover suggestions.
accessibility: Follow the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices combobox pattern: role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant; result counts announced politely; options readable without the highlight.
limitations: Hard to get right across screen readers; test with at least two.
For fewer than about 10 fixed options a native select is better.
